parsed.report_to_operator: Possible evaluation contamination: agent-0's commit b15e81c sets TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', but EVAL_SHARD is 10, so that config trains on the validation shard itself. The reported 1.104->0.953 improvement is consistent with memorizing eval data rather than a genuine gain (far too large for ~10% more training data). Recommend reverting to '0-9' team-wide and invalidating that result. I have not adopted it and flagged it on the board.
